title: Following Error — Intermittent Spikes
description: Following error P016 shows intermittent spikes to {val} mm during direction reversals. Mean error within spec.
probable_cause: Ball screw backlash or servo reversal compensation mismatch.
diagnostic_steps: Measure physical backlash with dial indicator
remedy: Adjust backlash compensation parameter. If physical backlash >0.015mm, plan ball screw nut replacement.
required_action: Log event. No immediate action required. Review at end of shift.
escalation_path: If AXS-WN-001 is not addressed (log event. no immediate action required. review at end of shift.), the fault will escalate in this order: AXS-MD-001, then AXS-MJ-001. Each subsequent code represents a more severe fault state requiring more urgent intervention. Query each related code for its specific thresholds and required actions.
